selection_boundary: Editorial selection of useful, interpretable examples from all twenty outcomes. This is not an estimate of uniform discovery success, novel scientific laws, or prospective confirmation. Partial studies can contain valid individual Rules while other analyses remain limited.

Retained as a parameter-free geometric consistency example. Two held-out files contain 78,227 events with magnitude errors near numerical precision. This recovers a known vector identity and validates representation consistency; it is not a new particle-physics law or an independent detector calibration.
